root_cause_evidence.crop_root_cause: body.read-page declares 'height:100vh; height:100dvh'. On real devices whose WebKit/Blink build lacks dynamic viewport units (older iOS Safari < 15.4, older Chrome/Android WebView, older in-app webviews), 100dvh is dropped and 100vh wins = the FULL visual viewport including the area under the browser address bar. body height then EXCEEDS the real visible area by the chrome height (~50-80px typical phone browser). The fixed four-zone flex column is sized to that over-tall body, so the last zone (audio player) lands partially or fully below the fold; .read-wrap{overflow:hidden} then crops it silently with no way to scroll to it. The prior safe-area fix only covered the iOS home indicator, not this. Fix = size the page from the REAL visible viewport: html-level 100% + dvh-with-vh-fallback handled via 100svh/100dvh ordering plus small-screen density budget; verify with emulated small effective heights.
root_cause_evidence.seek_root_cause: Computed CSS on the live page: input#audio-seek has height 6px (author), border-top/bottom 1px, box-sizing border-box AND padding 11px 13px leaked from the generic 'input,select,textarea' rule. Content box = 6 - 2(borders) - 22(vertical padding) => clamped to 0. WebKit sizes/positions the range track inside the content box and the thumb travel range is derived from it; with a 0px-tall content box the 16px thumb renders detached from the 6px visual track (vertical misalignment), and the --fill gradient (drawn across the full border box) cannot match the thumb position (horizontal mismatch, worst near the ends where thumb inset is 8px but fill reaches 0%/100% of the border box). Fix = padding:0 + margin:0 on the seek input (override the generic rule), plus track/border geometry that makes fill end exactly at the thumb at 0/50/100%.
